subtitle: "The International System of Units on flip cards"
description: "The 7 base units, the 22 named derived units and the prefixes of the International System of Units (SI), with the definitions in force since 2019. MACEDONIA Laboratory, UMCE."
toc: false
---

The **International System of Units** in three views: the **7 base units** with the constant that defines each, the **22 named derived units** (filterable by area) and the **prefixes** from quecto to quetta with a converter. Cards flip to show the definition and an example.
